hypothesis.name: Kneser graph
evidence: receivers = 715 and regular with degree 126 (degree_min = degree_max = 126)
spectrum_integral = true with 5 distinct eigenvalues 126, 21, 1, -6, -56 (alternating-sign pattern of a Kneser graph with k = 4)
common_neighbours_adjacent = [5], consistent with two disjoint 4-sets leaving 5 points
board lower = 220 from greedy independent set, upper = 260 from clique_cover

reply.analysis: Proven: beta = 220 for N = 715. The lower bound is an independent set of size 220 (check passed; CP-SAT also proves alpha = 220 in 12.2 s). The upper bound is a linear code M = I + 4A over F_5 of length 220; the fit, factorization and decoding checks all passed. Only 1 code was tried, after 1 critic round. Against the baselines, the agent matches kushagra_agent on accuracy (also exact 220, field 5) but is far slower: 93.9 s wall (61.5 s LLM, 32.4 s compute) against 0.28 s. CP-SAT cover (604, unproven), the fractional cover (635) and F2 minrank SAT (lower bound 219 only, no value) all fail to close the bracket. Nothing looks suspicious.
